paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Ammi: Rosh Hashanah 18a. Bar Immi, and R' Hinena bar Yitzhak: see his entry. The father of Shmuel bar Ammi, in Rav Yehudah's name: Jerusalem Sanhedrin and Ha-Gozel Etzim, halakhah 2. In Yevamot, chapter 10, halakhah 8: bar Immi, in R' Yehudah's name. R' Zeira said to him: Pesahim 16, beginning of side b. He said in R' Yonatan's name: Yevamot 105a. Avodah Zarah 35a: R' Shimon ben Pazi said; some say, R. Sh. bar Ammi [ר״ש]. Shmuel the Elder—see above—was his father-in-law. R' Ammi was his son.
